thread:
ana: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to migrate the Console/Observability pages: tracing hooks + dashboard cost/latency breakdowns + examples. PR will include: golden examples for Go + Ruby, a compact dashboard presets YAML, and a link-sweep for orphaned sample pages. Can we divvy up owners? Timeline: aim to merge by end of week if no blockers.

sasha: tagging @matt and @jen. I can take the link-sweep and dashboard schema review. Will run a smoke once snippets land.

matt: I can own the dashboard YAML and the cost/latency JSON example. Quick draft below for the presets (tiny):

```
presets:
  - id: kv-prefetch-cost
    title: "KV Prefetch: Cost vs Latency"
    widgets:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: requests.per_minute
      - type: timeseries
        metric: cost.per_token
        aggregate: p95
```

matt: That should be small enough for docs and the console import. Will also add a note about sequence length distribution affecting p95.

jen: I can do Go + Ruby snippets for the tracing hook + SDK examples. Question: do we want sync examples only, or include streaming & function-calls? Also, are we keeping the previous param names or switching to the new trace_key naming?

ana: (typo) ana: we should include both sync and streaming minimal examples. For trace key, switch to "trace_key" and add a compatibility note for older SDKs.

jen: ok. Go snippet (minimal) i can drop into the snippets folder: 

```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
ctx := context.Background()
span := client.Tracing().Start(ctx, "create_embedding")
resp, _ := client.Embeddings().Create(ctx, "hello world")
span.End()
```

jen: Will also add a tiny Ruby sample and cross-link to the SDK repo.

ana: Docs bot, can you create the PR and add labels?

docs-bot: PR created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 by ana. Labels: docs, obsv, needs-review.

sasha: FYI one of the existing sample pages links to an internal gist that 404s. Matt — when you do the sweep, please replace with the canonical sample repo link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/console-obsv. Also add a redirect note in the migration section.

matt: noted. I'll update the broken URL and add a short migration guide paragraph about migrating old dashboard YAMLs (key renames: cost_bucket -> cost_range, traceId -> trace_id).

jen: small question about snippet size limits — code blocks should be under 120 lines. If we need fuller examples, we can point to the samples repo and embed a trimmed excerpt. OK?

ana: yes, embed trimmed excerpt + link to full sample. Also add a short e2e smoke GitHub Action to validate the console import JSON/YAML and the examples render. Something like workflow: linter -> import-check -> deploy-preview.

matt: small JSON example for the cost breakdown widget to include in PR: 

```
{
  "widget": "cost_breakdown",
  "buckets": ["0-50", "50-200", ">200"],
  "measure": "tokens"
}
```

ana: perfect. Assigning owners: sasha = link-sweep + QA, matt = dashboard YAML + import JSON, jen = SDK snippets + examples. I'll shepherd the PR and do a final pass on the migration guide. Can everyone aim to review by Thursday EOD?

sasha: on it :mag: (I'll run the smoke tests and post results).

jen: will add Go + Ruby snippets and open a pair of small follow-ups if anything needs expansion.

ana: one more note — include a tiny section about cost/latency SLOs and how to interpret p50/p95 in the dashboard, plus a sample alert rule. That helps PMs communicate tradeoffs.

matt: good call. I'll add an example alert YAML too.

ana: if anyone finds additional orphaned samples while link-sweeping, drop them here and I'll triage. Plan: merge Fri EOD if green.

sasha: thumbs up.

jen: quick clarification on the Ruby trace snippet — using Trace.start(name) vs client.tracing.start? I'll just mirror the new SDK surface and add a compatibility note.

ana: mirror new SDK surface. thanks everyone — will ping again with PR link and review checklist.
